support_free_regions.name: Upward-facing long lower wing seat
support_free_regions.reason: The long lower wing bears on a print-up face. Its opposite face is the accessible backing supported above this pocket in machine Z.

support_free_regions.name: Backed flow meter aft shoulder
support_free_regions.reason: The permanent slope supports the boss crown. Trees pass beside its exposed face to reach the fore shoulder, lip and channels.

support_regions.name: Accessible flow meter fore shoulder
support_regions.reason: Support the exposed end shoulder through the open west side, clear of the fitted cap pocket.

support_regions.name: Accessible flow meter fore boss channel floor
support_regions.reason: Support the floor at its fitted height. The open west face admits a screwdriver above the support to pry it away.

support_regions.name: Accessible flow meter aft boss channel floor
support_regions.reason: Support the floor at its fitted height. The open west face admits a screwdriver above the support to pry it away.

support_regions.name: Accessible flow meter fore screw-head channel floor
support_regions.reason: Support the floor at its fitted height. The open west face admits a screwdriver above the support to pry it away.

support_regions.name: Accessible flow meter aft screw-head channel floor
support_regions.reason: Support the floor at its fitted height. The open west face admits a screwdriver above the support to pry it away.

support_regions.name: Accessible flow meter wire chamber floor
support_regions.reason: Support the floor at its fitted height. The open west face admits a screwdriver above the support to pry it away.

support_regions.name: Upper wing pilot, approach and retaining lip
support_regions.reason: The short upper hook prints over this crown. The open side above the receiver in machine Z lets it lift clear of the lip and out toward the west.

support_regions.name: Upper wing retaining shoulder and running guide
support_regions.reason: The short upper hook prints over this crown. The open side above the receiver in machine Z lets it lift clear of the lip and out toward the west.

support_regions.name: Accessible long lower hook backing
support_regions.reason: Support the exposed back of the long lower hook through the open west side of the wire chamber. Past the chamber the cheek is solidly backed.

support_regions.name: Accessible fore upper screw-head recess ledge
support_regions.reason: The flat ends of the recess widen at the curved bore. Their support pulls directly out to the west through the empty meter seat.

support_regions.name: Accessible aft upper screw-head recess ledge
support_regions.reason: The flat ends of the recess widen at the curved bore. Their support pulls directly out to the west through the empty meter seat.
